announcements.headline: Appointment of Liquidator
announcements.insight: Engage XR Holdings Plc has appointed a liquidator following its September suspension. This signals insolvency and likely total loss for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Suspension - Engage XR Holdings Plc
announcements.insight: Engage XR Holdings Plc shares are suspended following final results and AGM proceedings. Shareholders should monitor for further regulatory updates regarding the trading halt.

announcements.headline: Suspension of Shares
announcements.insight: Suspension of shares halts trading. Shareholders should monitor for further updates regarding the company's status following the AGM.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results. This follows the June 2026 final results announcement.

announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: Engage XR Holdings has published its final results. Shareholders should review the filing for financial performance details.
